console.name: sanitizer
console.title: Sanitizer
console.description: The violations of the exchange sanitizer, with their stacks, and the counts per rule

enabled.description: Whether the sanitizer is switched on: with profile dev, camel.sanitizer.enabled=true or @CamelSanitizer, never with profile prod

reason.description: Why the sanitizer is off (only when it is off)

calls.description: The calls of the processors of steps checked (only when it is on)

total.description: The violations reported, also those past the first 1000 that are counted but not listed (only when it is on)

rules.description: The violations reported per rule, such as R1 (only when it is on)

kinds.description: The violations reported per kind, every kind (only when it is on)

rule.description: The rule the violation breaks, such as R1

kind.description: The kind of violation, such as COMPLETED_TWICE

title.description: The kind of violation in plain words, such as: callback called twice

routeId.description: The id of the route of the step

stepId.description: The id of the step, such as process1 or to2

processor.description: The class name of the processor of the step, such as the processor or the bean of a user (only when it was found)

report.description: The full report of the violation, as logged: where it happened, the threads and their stacks, the class and message of what was thrown, and the usual fix

violations.description: The violations, the first 1000 in the order they were reported (only when it is on)
